Container.Name: qtopo-server
Container.Overview: QLD and NSW topographic map tiles with a browser map and read-only activity dashboard. Styles and cached tiles persist in /data. Storage cleanup protects files in use and removes old unused cache files when either storage threshold is reached.

Config.Name: Web and tile port
Config.Description: Open the map and status page on this host port. Change it if another container already uses 9878.

Config.Name: Persistent data
Config.Description: Styles and cached tiles. Use a separate folder for each running QTopo container.

Config.Name: Maximum cache size (GiB)
Config.Description: Maximum combined managed tile and resource cache size. Removes the oldest unused files when exceeded; files in use and styles are protected. 0 disables this limit.

Config.Name: Minimum free disk space (GiB)
Config.Description: Start removing old unused cache files when a cache filesystem has less free space than this, even below the cache-size limit. 0 disables this threshold.

Config.Name: Default appearance
Config.Description: Style for the map and unqualified tile URLs. Use readable or mobile, or the name of an installed profile.

Config.Name: Render workers
Config.Description: Maximum simultaneous render workers, 1-24. The memory guard may use fewer workers when RAM is limited.

Config.Name: Nearby prefetch radius
Config.Description: Prepare neighbouring tiles within this radius, 0-10. 0 disables nearby prefetch.

Config.Name: Prefetch neighbouring zoom levels
Config.Description: 1 prepares nearby zoom levels at lowest priority; 0 disables zoom prefetch.

Config.Name: Memory guard
Config.Description: 1 adapts render concurrency to available RAM; 0 disables adaptive throttling. Docker still enforces the container Memory limit.

Config.Name: Worker recycling threshold (MiB)
Config.Description: Replace a worker after its completed render if resident memory reaches this value, 64-4096 MiB. This fixed retention threshold is not a per-render memory limit or calculated from the container RAM allocation.
